name: Potion of Diminution

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: The Reduce part of Enlarge/Reduce for 1d4 hours (no Concentration).
text: When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 1d4 hours (no Concentration needed): you shrink one size, have Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, and your weapons deal 1d4 less damage. The red in the liquid keeps shrinking to a tiny bead and growing back.
